descriptions.text: Mysterious Letter. GumGum the orc had this blood-soaked letter in her possession. It's in an odd language. Is it a clue? Is it a grocery list? You can't fucking read it, so who knows?

recap.text: Mordecai reads the Mysterious Letter as a used necroscript scroll of Suppurating Eye, a common lich spell that lets the caster see and hear near the blood. Carl had been clutching it when he swore to hunt GumGum's killer. On a rooftop, Donut splits Mongo into three and Carl lights two smoke curtains. He crumples the letter and tosses it up, and a clockwork Mongo swallows it whole.

beats.headline: Squiggles and triangles
beats.text: The second paper from GumGum's body is a Mysterious Letter, folded and stained red with blood, a short note in a language that is all squiggles and triangles. The System is no help: a clue, or a grocery list? Mordecai recognises the squiggles, and sounds nervous. Necroscript, something an undead magic user would write out, probably a type of scroll, readable only with the language skill. Krasue are usually henchwomen for something else, he says, and the two of them might have a lich problem. That night Carl stares at the symbols, trying to memorise them.
beats.gist: Carl tries to memorise a blood-stained letter in necroscript, which Mordecai says means a lich problem.

beats.headline: A spy camera in blood
beats.text: Mordecai has worked the letter out. Carl swore, in a safe room, to hunt down whoever killed GumGum, and within moments a dead woman was dropped on the building with No you won't carved into her. He had been clutching the letter as he said it. It is a used necroscript scroll of Suppurating Eye, a common lich spell: the caster leaks a bodily fluid onto a surface and can see and hear anything near it, and he thinks the blood on this one is the caster's. It does not work from inside an inventory. Donut wants to use it, so on a rooftop she and Carl talk for whoever is listening.
beats.gist: Mordecai identifies the letter as a Suppurating Eye scroll, a spy camera in blood.

beats.headline: Swallowed whole
beats.text: Donut splits Mongo into three and pulls the real one back into his carrier, and Carl sets two lit smoke curtains billowing over the rooftops. Then he pulls the letter out. We're jumping onto the roof now, he says, crumples it up and tosses it in the air. One of the clockwork Mongos grabs it and swallows it whole, and the pair leap across the alley and a full story up to the top of the magistrate's building, one of them howling into the night.
beats.gist: Donut splits Mongo into three, Carl throws smoke and a crumpled letter, and a clockwork Mongo swallows it.
